title: JNIM Storms FAMa Barracks in San, Ségou Region — Militants' Reach Extends South Toward Bamako Approaches
detail: JNIM fighters attacked and temporarily occupied FAMa's main barracks in San, Ségou Region, on August 9, 2026. AFP wire reporting, widely republished, cited a provisional toll of at least 10 soldiers killed and military equipment seized; a separate aggregator cited 12 killed. JNIM claimed in a statement that it had 'taken full control of a Malian army barracks in the town of San... this morning.' Mali's military said it conducted a 'vigorous riposte' and had the situation 'under control,' claiming roughly 40 militants killed — a figure that is disputed and unverified. San lies well south of the historical northern Mali front line, closer to Bamako's approaches, and the assault is the most recent confirmed JNIM attack in the tracker's window, illustrating the group's continued southward reach even as the Bamako fuel blockade persists.
